tip.desc: Velociraptors are the most common dinosaurs, they are fast, but quite weak. Keep distance from them for the best odds at beating them.
Turboraptors are a faster, deadlier variant of the velociraptor. Weapons with high DPS or knockback are the best way to deal with them.
The Megaraptor is the deadliest of all the raptors. It possesses medium speed, high health and damage, and a large variety of attacks. Always stay mobile when facing it.
Killosauruses are less common than velociraptors, but still common. They are slow but their venom is difficult to dodge up close, keep distance from them.
Frillosauruses are one of the rarer dinosaurs. They can spit more often and their venom stays on the ground, dealing additional damage when walked over.
The Killosaurus Rex is the strongest Killosaurus. It has high stats, and more attacks. It can stun and spit venom to the side, though it is not very fast. Rifles are a bad choice for it.
Triceratops are fairly common dinosaurs, they can charge forwards and melee you when close. They also have medium health, crossbows perform well against them.
Triserratops are less common, more deadly variants of triceratops. They charge faster, and can throw rocks at you, crossbows perform well against them too.
The Triterrortops is the absolute peak of the species, it is fast, has high health and damage, charges much more, throws more rocks, and can stun. Never stop moving when fighting it.
Pterodactyls are the most common sky dinosaurs, they only have a single easy to dodge melee attack which does low damage and they have low health, melee weapons are the best against them.
Teradactyls are the other main sky dinosaurs, they fly above you at high speed and occasionally charge towards you, though they have no melee attacks. Crossbows are the best against them.
The Terrordactyl combines the best of the Pterodactyl and Teradactyl. It has melee attacks, and two rush attacks making it a greater threat than the both, though its size makes it easy to hit.
The Amphibious Pterodactyl is the most powerful Pterodactyl. It has melee, rush, and ranged attacks and it can evem choose to either walk or fly. You must keep moving to deal with this threat.
The T-Rex is the perfect apex predator. High health, speed, and damage. It can sprint at you, throw rocks that stun, and swing its tail when close. It is best to fight it at medium distance.
The Spine King is a threat at close and far range, it is very deadly up close and it can toss rocks in random directions and charge at you. Though it is easier to fight at a medium distance.

The Spikosaurus is a unique threat. It can tunnel underground and it can slash when close and it has medium health, though when underground, AOE can still damage it. It is best to bring any AOE for it.
The Spikeferus is similar to the Spikosaurus, though it enters a second phase upon reaching zero health where it begins reviving itself. Prioritize killing it before it can revive itself.
These bugs are fairly common, though they pose less of a threat than most enemies. They explode when close, and have low health. Most weapons will work against them.
These are a more deadly type of bug, as when killed, they drop a few smaller bugs, though the small bugs die instantly from any hits.

The Stegosaurus is the deadliest close-mid range threat. It has a powerful slam attack, a leap attack, and a roll attack and it can sprint towards you. Using crossbows and rifles together is the best way to defeaat it.

A Stegosaur is a significantly weaker Stegosaurus, being a very slow dinosaur with its only attack being a ground slam, but it has high health and damage, making crossbows at medium range ideal for defeating it.

A Stegosaurite is a slightly weaker, slightly slower Stegosaur, though it can heal slowly and it stuns for longer with its slams making it a greater threat. Keep distance from this threat, but do not stop shooting it.
Shotguns are good for crowd control and knockback, though mediocre against singular targets.

Crossbows are amazing for single target DPS, having the highest raw DPS out of any weapon type, though their crowd control potential is limited. Bring an AOE weapon or use your melee with a crossbow for great results.
Cannons are great overall crowd control weapons but deal low DPS against singular targets. Alongside their low DPS, they cannot crit, they fire slowly, and they reload slowly too. Use with precision.
Rifles boost your speed slightly but deal relatively low damage. It is best to use it for dodging, though not for damage.
Flamethrowers deal the greatest crowd control DPS, though they lack knockback and will run out of ammo quicker. Best used when you don't need much knockback, otherwise use cannons or shotguns.
Melee weapons are the best all-rounder weapons, featuring good DPS, high crit chance, multi-target hitting, and knockback. They are forced into the first weapon slot, but for a good reason.
